name: 3S Viking Status (GMCP)
author: Joakim
description: The settlement half of the Viking HUD, fed by the Guild.* GMCP packages (3Scapes only; the MIP-fed original ships as '3S Viking Status (classic, MIP)' - run one or the other, they answer to the same commands). Tabs: Stats / City / Builds / Production / People / Settlers / Holds / Plan / Mission / Trade / Trade Auto / Trade Log / Feeds - the Sea, Voyage, Map and Travel tabs move to 3s-viking-sea (the mission runner's town-travel engine and the vgo/vhere commands stay here). Includes the build planner and the market scanner + auto-trader. Warehouse stock comes straight from the Guild.Warehouse feed (server-side since 28 Aug) with real per-grade freshness; the `vtrade stock` text scan - Refresh button, `vstock`, cart-event and staleness re-scans - remains only as the automatic fallback for a server without that package. An incoming raid (Guild.City raid) shows on the Stats tab's War section, damaged buildings (bdmg) on the Builds tab. Remaining GMCP feed gaps show honestly in their tabs.
